description: Turn airplane mode on and off on a schedule Airplane Scheduler turns airplane mode on and off on a schedule, so your phone goes quiet at night without you having to remember. Features • Any number of schedules, one-off or repeating on any days of the week. • Supports overnight time ranges automatically. • Skip or end a schedule early. • Optionally turns off Wi-Fi at the start and back on at the end. • Undoes only what it changed: airplane mode or Wi-Fi that you set yourself stays as you left it. • An optional reminder an hour before a schedule starts if Shizuku isn't ready. • No internet access, ads or tracking. Note This app requires Shizuku to function.
